sources.title: Apple M1 Max (24-GPU) - Benchmarks & Specs - CPU Monkey
sources.snippet: A large system level cache additionally buffers memory accesses by the CPU and GPU. A defining feature of the M1 Max is its wide memory interface: the LPDDR5-6400 memory is connected via a 512-bit bus and reaches a bandwidth of around 400 GB/s. The chip shipped with 32 or 64 GB, which the CPU, GPU and Neural Engine share as unified memory.
